title: fix(worker): settle aborts when remote cancellation arrives first
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes managed worker `chat.abort` exiting before terminal settlement when Gateway inference cancellation arrives before local worker cancellation.

## User Impact

Cancelled worker turns finish their terminal acknowledgment without attempting another transcript write after Gateway authority has been revoked. Existing authority refusals, submitted-write settlement, and replacement fences remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The inference adapter marked the assistant response aborted but left the worker's turn controller live. That allowed a second transcript request, which Gateway correctly refused, preventing finishing. The adapter now propagates remote cancellation to the existing turn controller before publishing the terminal model event and removes the inference abort listener first to avoid a cancellation echo.

The existing after-durable-ACK test deterministically delays local cancellation until finishing. PR CI also exposed a stale paired-node fixture: losing the node cancel acknowledgment no longer prevents a worker from completing through the repaired inference channel. The fixture now drops only that run's cancelled inference terminal at a local wire proxy, keeping the node control channel live. This genuinely forces unconfirmed cleanup while preserving every physical-stop, claim, successor-order, and deadline assertion. No production behavior changed in this follow-up.

## Evidence

- The original deterministic reproduction failed with two transcript requests, preview reached, finishing absent, 38 ms after cancellation; all 106 original focused cases passed after the production fix.
- The Bun CI fixture hang was reproduced at `stopEntered` while the real worker had already exited, its launch journal was completed, and placement claims were cleared. The diagnostic run was stopped after identifying that wait.
- With the corrected wire fault, the complete paired-node E2E file passes on pinned Bun 1.4.4-canary.1+7bd4fdff3: 2/2 cases, 229.20 s test-file time (258.74 s Vitest). Its multi-process lifecycle and physical cleanup contracts require the real wire composition.
- Worker/runtime and chat-abort suites pass all 79 cases on each of Node 24.22.0 and pinned Bun, including remote-first cancellation and durable ACK fences. The complete paired-node E2E file also passes both cases on Node 24.22.0 (220.37 s test-file time, 261.02 s Vitest). Both runtimes therefore pass all 81 requested cases each.
- E2E type graph, targeted lint, formatting, line-cap ratchet, and independent P2 review pass. Assertions and timeouts are unchanged; no CI reruns.
